The 4-second lower third is in `./s3/`, and `npx hyperframes check` passes with 0 errors. I didn't render it or look at the output.

"Mohammed" and "Maintainer, Girth" sit on a dark card with a teal edge bar. The card slides in from the left over about 0.7 s, and the title fades in just after it. Both hold until 4 s. It uses Montserrat on a slate background, which differs from your recent Inter, dark and amber work. The layout lives in `s3/compositions/lower-third.html`, mounted from `s3/index.html`.

I fixed the lint warning about nested elements by moving the card into its own sub-composition. Two things still show up in the check:
- **`first_frame_empty` warning:** frame 0 shows only the background and a small static teal bar, because the card enters from off-screen. That comes with a slide-in. I added the bar so the first frame isn't blank, but the warning remains.
- **Three layout infos:** they report text and the card overflowing the canvas edge mid-slide. That is the intended entrance.

I also recorded the choices (lower-third, 4s, slate, Montserrat, teal) with `girth made`.
